|lore=Stolen Imperial ''Lambda''-class shuttle. Supposedly carried parts and technical crew. Delivered General Solo’s crack team of Rebel scouts to the forest moon of Endor.
|game_text=May deploy (with a pilot) without presence or Force icons. May add 2 pilots and 6 passengers. May forfeit a scout aboard to cancel all remaining battle damage against you.
|printings={{Card versions/Tydirium}}

|notes=The recovered original Players Committee sheet is linked from the [[Tydirium (V) (Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon) (Original 2005)|2005 publication]]. The later free deployment permission requires a pilot and explicitly bypasses presence or Force icons. The scout-pilot discount is removed. A scout forfeiture replaces the original automatic damage protection for a solitary piloted ship. The historical full face adds here, which matches where the participating scout is forfeited under the period rules. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=55 Period rule or ruling].
